sources.summary: This University of Porto conference marks the 55th anniversary of the UNESCO World Heritage Convention. It explores heritage across art, architecture, history, museums, digital culture, tourism, sustainability and communities, making it fully interdisciplinary. Taking place in Porto, it is held in a city that characterizes the issues at play: a coastal city, a historic maritime centre and Europe’s first protected wine region. Its core is a World Heritage Site and a National Monument of Portugal. From this unique setting, the conference considers questions of heritage globally. Publications by UCL Press & Intellect Books. Conference Type: In-person & Virtual (Pre-recorded and written
